title: Fluorescence and phosphorescence of tetracarboxylated ZnPc–perylene diimide organic systems in highly acidic media
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,11105-11116
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06479A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Vadim Furtuna, Ion Lungu, Tamara Potlog, Alexandrina Druta, Anton Airinei
Co-assembly of TcPcZn and EP-PDI in acidic TFA/H2O enables tunable excited-state lifetimes and room-temperature phosphorescence, providing design principles for efficient organic photosensitizers in photodynamic therapy and optoelectronics.
